notes.title: Join our second playtest and get a limited edition hat!
notes.content:
Claim your very own head warmer by joining our little town of Berwick on Saturday the 12th of October at 3pm and 8pm UTC+1

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44738105/50f3534f5d01fab0429b3addb1f25733a4b88c8c.png[/img]

[h2]What to do:[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435100/Sweetlads_Werewolf/  

•	Press that big green request access button on Steam page above 
•	Download the game,
•	And Join us this Saturday!

[h2]Frequently asked questions:[/h2]

Q: What platforms do you support?
A: Windows, we will build Mac OS and Linux builds for the full release

Q: Why am I lagging?
A: We only have one server based in the UK so you may see a delay in other regions. Either way, please report this on the survey you'll receive access to when playing!

Q: If I turn up to both events, can I get two hats?
A: Only 1 hat can be claimed per Steam account

[h2]Update:[/h2]

Upon seeing the diverse global turn-out, we decided to generate localisation using Google Translate. We will get an expert to translate for the full release

Supported languages:
english
español
français
deutsch
português
русский
한국어
中文

Can’t wait? Follow us for updates:
Discord: https://discord.gg/TvUDBnzbdV
X: https://x.com/Sweetlads_WW

notes.title: Sweetlads' Werewolf Playtest
notes.content:
[h1]Be among the first to play our game at our playtest on Sunday the 5th of November, 21:00 GMT!
[/h1]

[h2]What to do:[/h2]

•	Click “request access” on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435100/Sweetlads_Werewolf/]storepage[/url]
•	Follow us on [url=https://discord.gg/TvUDBnzbdV]Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/Sweetlads_WW]X[/url] for updates
•	Check your mail on the day

Throughout the event, we’ll use Steam to randomly mail invitations to amount of players from those who’ve requested access.

[h2]Things to note:[/h2]

•	An invitation is not guaranteed
•	An invite doesn’t guarantee access as we have a limited number of spaces
•	You’ll have a chance to be added to the credits for your feedback 
•	The build is in English, runs on Windows and requires 200mb of space and an internet connection
•	This is a work in progress that can be faulty, service is not guaranteed.
•	Recording is allowed on the day

I’d like to personally apologise for our previous missed events. We have ensured this build works on our end and we will do everything we can to keep it working on the day.


We can’t wait to share what we’ve been working on!
